title: Birth, neighborhood and Paul's birth
summary: Mares was born in 1908 near Broad and Esplanade; Paul was born around 1900.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Mind you, the beginning of your life, the starting, when you were born, where you were raised, what part of town and all? A little bit about your father and your family.
Well, Bill, I was born in 1908, and I come from back on Broad and Espanade. That's back of town in New Orleans.
Can you remember when Paul was born? How much older was he?
Yeah, Paul was born on the turn, at the 1900. Paul would be with the years right now.
He'd be 60 years old. Remember the exact date?
Paul was born in, I think, I don't know the exact date, probably in March somewhere, but I just don't offhand know the date.
